title: Guitar Note Visualizer
description: Desktop-first browser tuner that listens through the microphone, detects a stable single pitch, and visualizes the note, cents offset, piano class, and optional staff.

title: Guitar Chord Companion
description: Chrome extension for supported guitar tab sites that adds chord diagrams, stable practice views, saved song history, YouTube caption syncing, romanization, and draggable practice tools.

title: SwitchBot Tools
description: Local-first CLI for controlling SwitchBot lights, scenes, and nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices, with installable shell commands, setup diagnostics, and credential-safe workflows.

title: Subtitle Companion MVP
description: Static subtitle companion for Japanese study that loads local subtitle files, follows a virtual playback clock, supports furigana and dictionary lookups, and exports saved words for Anki.

title: VGM Recordings Browser
description: Static media browser for 2026 video game music recordings with CSV-backed metadata, local thumbnails, Google Drive previews, inline audio playback, and filtered multi-select downloads.

title: XGIMI Projector Wake over BLE
description: Reverse-engineering case study that mapped the XGIMI Elfin projector wake signal from Bluetooth Low Energy captures, proved a working ESP32 wake path, and documented why native macOS advertising could not emit the required manufacturer payload.

title: Aiko Dictionary
description: A macOS dictionary app for Japanese learners, currently an early alpha build.

title: Train Shade Seat
description: Recommends which side of a train will get less direct sun, based on the line, direction of travel, time of day, and sun position.
